Story (internet-translated):

You arrived at the place she specified as promised.
"Long time no see, Commander of Gray Raven."
- It's been a long time indeed. Your change...is quite big.
"Oh? Tell me."
- Your belly...
"Humph, isn't this a gift from you?"
- Huh? !
"You'd better not tell me that you forgot our 'date', otherwise... I'll have to think carefully about how to punish you."
- Of course I remember! I just can't accept it for a while, I didn't expect you to actually be pregnant...
"It's too late to regret it now. But don't worry, our child is 100% human, and I have been eating human food during my pregnancy. The baby is safe and healthy in my belly."
- Well, I understand. Thank you.
"Okay, then I think you should also understand why I called you here suddenly, right?"
- Could it be...
"Yes, my water broke just now. As the father of the child, you must also want to see the birth process of the child with your own eyes, right?"
- How can I help you?
"Just watch it carefully. I will tell you if necessary."
…
"Well...it looks like it will be out soon. Hey, you can join in now."
- What do you want me to do?
"The baby is coming out, pick it up."
- What? ! etc! stop! You are flying too high! Come down quickly!
"Haha~"
- This is no fun at all!
"Looking at your surprised and frightened expression, this thing in itself is very fun. Besides, didn't you catch the newborn baby well?"
- Can you stop it for me?
"Stop complaining, the second baby is about to come~"
- What? ! Come again? ! Are you serious? !
"Haha! You can't imagine how happy I am now!"
- With a mother like you, our children are really unlucky for eight lifetimes...
